```yaml
name: Bump Progressive Rollout Version Command

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pr_number:
        description: 'PR number'
        required: true
        type: number

jobs:
  bump_version:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install airbyte-ci

      - name: Bump version with RC suffix
        run: |
          airbyte-ci connectors --modified bump-version --rc
        env:
          GH_PAT_APPROVINGTON_OCTAVIA: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT_APPROVINGTON_OCTAVIA }}

      - name: Create comment with next steps
        id: create_comment
        uses: actions/github-script@v4
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const prNumber = parseInt(${{ github.event.inputs.pr_number }});
            const commentBody = `
              ## Next Steps
              1. Review the updated version in your PR.
              2. Merge the PR once ready.
              3. Monitor the connector during the progressive rollout.
            `;
            await github.rest.issues.createComment({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: prNumber,
              body: commentBody
            });

      - name: Check if comment creation was successful
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "::set-output name=comment_id::${{ steps.create_comment.outputs.comment_id }}"
          if [[ -z "${{ steps.create_comment.outputs.comment_id }}" ]]; then
            echo "Failed to create comment"
            exit 1
          fi
```
